question.text: Which of the following is NOT listed among the 18 eligibility activities for identifying a Social Enterprise per p.16 of the workbook?

answer.text: Promoting healthcare including mental healthcare, sanitation and safe drinking water
Protection of national heritage, art and culture
Facilitating foreign exchange remittance services for diaspora communities

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.16 of the workbook, 18 eligibility activities are listed for identifying a Social Enterprise. Foreign exchange remittance is NOT among them. The list includes eradicating hunger/poverty/inequality, promoting healthcare, education, gender equality, environmental sustainability, heritage, sports, SE incubators, rural livelihoods, slum/affordable housing, disaster management, financial inclusion, land access, bridging digital divide, migrant welfare and other Schedule VII items. The Trap: Options A, B and D are drawn from the eligibility list on p.16. Option C (forex remittance) sounds plausible because fintech models exist in this space, but the workbook lists 'promotion of financial inclusion', not forex remittance. Note: p.16 lists 18 eligibility activities; p.69 identifies projects/activities listed under Regulation 292E for ZCZP issuance; p.117 separately lists 16 SAS thematic areas. Do not conflate the SAS thematic list with the eligibility activity list.
